run_nyu_depth_v2_fake_data_generation: run the script to generate fake NYU Depth V2 HDF5 data files with random rgb and depth datasets
create_fake_rgb_data: create fake rgb image data as a uint8 numpy array matching the shape of the source dataset
create_fake_depth_data: create fake depth data as a numpy array matching the dtype of the source dataset
build_write_hdf5_file: build and write an HDF5 file with gzip-compressed rgb and depth datasets
read_source_hdf5: read rgb and depth datasets from the source NYU Depth V2 HDF5 file
